lines.zh: 我拍着翅膀在树干间飘。
lines.en: I drift between the trunks on soft wingbeats.
The dark forest is dense; I fly low.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扫过一片蘑菇。
lines.en: My wings brush over a patch of mushrooms.
When the wind stops, I sink a little.

lines.zh: 我绕着同一棵树转了三圈。
lines.en: I circle the same tree three times.

lines.zh: 我落在树皮上，歇一会儿。
lines.en: I land on the bark to rest a while.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的粉落在叶子上。
lines.en: Powder from my wings dusts the leaves.
I follow the moonlight and dodge the branches.
I travel this stretch of woods every day.
I fly slowly, but my heading is true.

lines.zh: 两只翅膀一起扇，声音很轻。
lines.en: Both wings beat together, very softly.
I rise along a single beam of light.
A twig has caught my wingtip.

lines.zh: 我从树冠的缝里穿过去。
lines.en: I slip through a gap in the canopy.

lines.zh: 我避开蛛网，那东西粘翅膀。
lines.en: I avoid the cobwebs; they stick to wings.

lines.zh: 一只枭从头顶掠过，我躲到叶下。
lines.en: An owl passes overhead, and I duck under the leaves.

lines.zh: 我停在蘑菇上，一动不动。
lines.en: I sit on a mushroom without moving.
My antennae turn in the breeze.
I still remember the taste of sugar.
I wipe my face with my front legs.
The tree shadows move; I do not.

lines.zh: 我在等月亮升到树顶上。
lines.en: I wait for the moon to clear the treetops.
Six slots of storage will not hold much.
The nectar of this tree is a little thin.
I spread my wings flat to dry them.

lines.zh: 林子太暗，我靠气味认路。
lines.en: The woods are dark; I know the way by scent.

lines.zh: 有只蜘蛛在树下，别过去。
lines.en: There is a spider below the tree; stay back.
I slowly fold my wings and sleep.
You are under the tree, looking up at me.

lines.zh: 你的火把把我的影子放大了。
lines.en: Your torch makes my shadow huge.

lines.zh: 我落在你帽子上，不介意吧。
lines.en: I land on your hat; you do not mind?
Do you have sugar? Let me sniff.
I tilt my antennae at you.
You are much brighter than the dark forest.
I flew one circle around your head.
Your hand comes up and I do not flee.
I rest on your shoulder for a moment.

lines.zh: 你一口气把我吹得打转。
lines.en: One breath of yours spins me around.
A tear has opened in my wing.
Ten points of life, half gone in one hit.

lines.zh: 我掉到落叶里，爬不起来。
lines.en: I drop into the leaf litter and cannot rise.
Do not step; I am under your foot.
My wing dust is scattered on the ground.
The pain makes me curl all six legs.
I cannot fly now; I can only crawl.

lines.zh: 这一击把我的翅脉打断了。
lines.en: That strike snapped a vein in my wing.
I land on a mushroom and gasp.
Be gentle; I am very small.
Sugar! You have sugar in your hand.
A melon slice will do; I am not picky.
That little white heap; give it here.
I land on your finger and wait.

lines.zh: 甜的东西我从来不吃亏。
lines.en: I never pass up anything sweet.
Do not wave it; I cannot hold on.
Let me taste it, just a little.
Flatten your hand and I will come down.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀自己就扇快了。
lines.en: My wings speed up on their own.
Sugar is far sweeter than nectar.
You bump me; I take off and dodge.

lines.zh: 翅膀折了个角，我飞歪了。
lines.en: A corner of my wing bent; I fly crooked.
I am so light that one bump floats me away.
Do not swat me; I bruise easily.

lines.zh: 我在你面前晃了一下，稳住。
lines.en: I wobble in front of you, then steady.
Your shoulder is harder than a tree trunk.
After the bump I land on your boot.
I shed a few flakes of wing powder.

lines.zh: 林子这么空，你还撞得到我。
lines.en: The woods are wide and you still hit me.
Leave me a gap between the trunks.

lines.zh: 我在树干上等她飞过来。
lines.en: I wait on the trunk for her to fly over.
Her wings are whiter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一盏月光转。
lines.en: We circle the same patch of moonlight.
I give her half of my sugar.

lines.zh: 两只蛾子贴着树皮，很安静。
lines.en: Two moths on the bark, very quiet.
Do not shine that torch at us.
Our wing dust will mingle.
She flies a loop; I fly one behind her.

lines.zh: 这片黑森林够养一窝幼虫。
lines.en: This dark forest can feed a brood.

lines.zh: 我落在她旁边，收起翅膀。
lines.en: I settle beside her and fold my wings.
Six slots; I have to choose carefully.
I will carry this sugar in my legs.
This chunk of wood outweighs me.
I snatch a petal and go.
My bags are full; I drop the stone.
This seed is light; just right.
I clamp it in my legs and hold.
Someone dropped a crumb of sugar.
I can carry it, but not fly high.
I take only sweet things and touch nothing else.
Something behind the tree is breathing.
A beam of firelight entered the dark forest.
Something snapped a dead branch.
My antennae felt it before I did.
That spider is spinning its web again.
The scent the wind carries is wrong.

lines.zh: 我飞高了半格，看清一点。
lines.en: I rise half a block to see better.
A shadow has stopped beneath the tree.

lines.zh: 它离我的蘑菇越来越近。
lines.en: It is getting closer to my mushroom.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢这个方向的风。
lines.en: I do not like the wind from that direction.
Something is turning over my leaves.
I fix on it with my wings still.
I hover above it and descend slowly.
It looks up; I drift to the side.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀张到最大，吓它。
lines.en: I spread my wings wide to frighten it.
If it reaches out, I climb.

lines.zh: 我绕着树皮找它的侧面。
lines.en: I circle the bark to find its flank.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛跟着我转，累了。
lines.en: Its eyes track me until they tire.
I pretend to be large; I am not.
I press to the bark and wait it out.
One more step and I go for its face.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在它鼻子上。
lines.en: My shadow lands on its nose.

lines.zh: 别动，我在数扇几下翅膀。
lines.en: Hold still; I am counting my wingbeats.
It backs off, so I stop chasing.
I bump its face for a mere two points.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇起的粉迷了它的眼。
lines.en: My wing dust gets in its eyes.

lines.zh: 我用腿蹬了一下它的鼻子。
lines.en: I kick its nose with my legs.
That strike knocked me off balance too.

lines.zh: 我在它耳垂上咬了一小口。
lines.en: I take a tiny bite of its earlobe.
It swings; I climb out of reach.
I lunge once, then flee.
Two points of pain; it likely felt nothing.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀打在它额头上。
lines.en: My wing slaps its forehead.
When it is done I hide behind the leaves.

lines.zh: 我从黑森林的树皮里钻出。
lines.en: I emerge from the bark of a dark forest tree.

lines.zh: 月光照到我的翅膀，我醒了。
lines.en: Moonlight found my wings and I woke.
This wood is dark, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我的第一口空气有蘑菇味。
lines.en: My first breath tasted of mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我把新翅膀对着月光张开。
lines.en: I open my new wings toward the moonlight.
Above the canopy it is all black.

lines.zh: 我落在最低的那根枝上。
lines.en: I land on the lowest branch.
Another moth fluttered past me.
I knew moonlight from the moment I was born.
Dark forest hills; I choose this place.

lines.zh: 火把靠太近，我的翅尖焦了。
lines.en: The torch was too close; my wingtip is singed.
I fell from the canopy and landed dazed.

lines.zh: 林子里的水洼比我想的深。
lines.en: The puddle in the woods is deeper than I thought.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，我的翅粉全飞了。
lines.en: A bang, and all my wing dust blew away.

lines.zh: 有根针刺穿了我的翅膀。
lines.en: A needle has pierced my wing.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的触角发麻。
lines.en: That force numbs my antennae.
I am so hungry I lick the bark.

lines.zh: 闪电把整片林子照亮了。
lines.en: Lightning lit the whole forest white.
The emptiness below makes me dizzy.
